neighbours.label: The slot where a time or effort requirement is expected: what will take time, may require longer, or needs N weeks to recover (the output promotes needing/requiring/patience)
fire: Deep stains may require several washes before they fade.
Real change in the schools will take years, not weeks.
Most patients need about six weeks to recover from the surgery.
Orders usually arrive within 3 to 5 working days.
Thick coats of varnish may need longer to dry fully.
Lasting solutions to the housing shortage will take time.
Healing after a fracture can take several months.
Building trust with a new team takes patience.
quiet: Deep stains are common on white cotton shirts.
Real change in the schools began with new teachers.
Most patients go home on the day of the surgery.
Orders are packed in recycled cardboard boxes.
Thick coats of varnish give the table a glossy look.
Lasting solutions to the housing shortage were discussed at the meeting.
Healing herbs grow in the garden behind the clinic.
Building a new team is the manager's first task.

notes: Card: 'solutions [will take time]', 'colors may [require longer]', 'took three months [to recover]', 'within 5 [to 9 working days]', German 'Stellung gen[ommen]'; output promotes needing/requiring/patience and suppresses ' it'. (The opposite pole fires on 'time'/'what' before 'it takes'.) Not probed.
